goal: 寻找复合干热事件影响陆地植被 SIF 的代表性论文并建立后续精读候选
deliverable: 5–8篇带来源核验状态的候选论文清单

inclusions: 陆地植被的太阳诱导叶绿素荧光对干旱/热浪及其复合的响应
exclusions: 与植被响应无关的医学热浪研究

concept_groups.rationale: 覆盖 SIF 全称与缩写

sources.reason: 若宿主工具可用则执行语义检索

queries.query_text: This study examines satellite solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence responses of terrestrial vegetation to drought and heatwave events. It evaluates how extreme climate stress changes photosynthetic signals and discusses limitations of SIF monitoring.

inclusion_rules: 必须直接分析陆地植被响应与SIF相关结果
exclusion_rules: 排除不涉及植被响应的研究
assumptions: 示例数据，用于 schema 校验，未执行任何真实检索
